svg.aria-label: PocketGull Philocardia Real-Time 72 BPM Heart-Tittle Motion Specimen
svg.title: PocketGull v4.0 Philocardia Real-Time 72 BPM Heart-Tittle Specimen
svg.desc: Real-time 72.0 BPM (0.833s cardiac sinus cycle) vector specimen of PocketGull v4.0 showing OpenType cv09 and ss07 heart tittles on i and j pulsing in lockstep with a P-QRS-T ECG trace while letter stems remain at 0.000 CLS.
